source: every melonDS savestate on disk, across all three state directories
reader: the main-RAM offset is located by matching a known overlay image inside the file, NOT by walking the save-work chain. The chain is zeroed before a character exists and returns garbage bases on exactly those states -- over these files it yields seven distinct offsets where the overlay locator yields the two the format actually uses, 0x24 and 0x54. See docs/game-state-gaps.md gap 6.
resident_overlay: ov00..ov18 share one address, so exactly one is resident and which one IS the game's notion of its mode. It is recorded per state here for the first time.
